pages.title: Products
pages.content:
Home / Products

Products

Products

Denki Components B.V. makes multilayer ceramic capacitors, thick-film chip resistors, power inductors and ferrite chip beads at one plant in Eindhoven. The catalogue holds 1,240 part numbers across 13 series.

(01) DC series

Ceramic capacitors

Multilayer ceramic capacitors leave Eindhoven under four series codes: DC-C0G for C0G/NP0, DC-X7R, DC-X5R and DC-AQ for automotive. The family spans sizes 0201–1210, capacitance from 0.5 pF to 100 µF, and rated voltage from 6.3 V to 100 V. DC-AQ is an AEC-Q200 qualified series. A full reel of a catalogue part has a standard lead time of 6 weeks. The same codes are used on the sample desk, so a request can name the exact part rather than a description. September 2026 output across all four families, capacitors included, was 1.8 bn pieces shipped. Applications support for this family sits with Amara Osei, who joined as applications engineer for capacitors in 2017.

0201–1210 · 0.5 pF–100 µF · 6.3–100 V

See the range→

(02) DR series

Chip resistors

Thick-film chip resistors use the DR prefix. DR-TF is the thick-film series, DR-PR is the precision series at 0.1%, DR-AS is the anti-sulfur series, and DR-AQ is the automotive series. DR-AQ is AEC-Q200 qualified. The 0402 resistor kit on the samples list, K-R04, holds the E24 set: 170 values, 50 pieces each, at 1%, for €48 excluding VAT. Catalogue reels follow the same 6-week standard lead time as the other families. Where a board has seen sulfur in the field, DR-AS is the series we put forward, with the flowers-of-sulfur work described on the cases page. The catalogue as a whole lists 1,240 part numbers across 13 series.

0201–2512 · 1 Ω–10 MΩ · 0.1–5%

See the range→

(03) DL series

Power inductors

Power inductors are series DL-PW: shielded parts specified by inductance, rated current and DCR. DL-PW is AEC-Q200 qualified, with DC-AQ and DR-AQ. The power inductor kit, K-L01, contains 24 values, five pieces each, from the DL-PW series, priced at €72 excluding VAT. Rahul Menon, inductor design lead since 2011, works on winding changes when a design needs lower DCR. Multilayer inductors sit beside this range as DL-ML and are listed on the inductors and beads page. Approved samples of catalogue part numbers are dispatched in 3 working days, with the datasheet and a lot report. Production quotes follow within 5 working days of that dispatch.

2016–5050 · 0.47–100 µH · 0.8–9 A

See the range→

(04) DF series

Ferrite beads

Ferrite chip beads are DF-FB and the high-current series DF-HC. Both are specified by impedance at 100 MHz, rated current and DCR. The ferrite bead kit, K-F01, holds 30 values, 20 pieces each, drawn from DF-FB and DF-HC, at €39 excluding VAT. Beads are taped on the same three lines as capacitors, resistors and inductors. The plant runs 24 hours a day in three shifts, and the reel store holds 41,000 reels. A bead that is already in the catalogue can be sampled under the free allowance: up to 5 catalogue part numbers, 50 pieces each, for a qualified project. Kit shipping, when a paid kit is ordered, is €12 within the EU and €28 elsewhere.

0201–1206 · 10–2,000 Ω at 100 MHz · 0.1–6 A

See the range→

Part numbers

How to read our part numbers

A ceramic part number is read in a fixed order. Take DC 0402 X7R 104 K 500. DC names the capacitor family. 0402 is the chip size. X7R is the dielectric and selects the DC-X7R series. 104 is the capacitance code. K is the tolerance code. 500 is the voltage code. The same field order is used on DC-C0G, DC-X5R and DC-AQ, so a purchasing file can be checked against the catalogue one field at a time. Resistors use the DR prefix, inductors DL, and ferrite beads DF. The catalogue holds 1,240 part numbers across 13 series. If a code is not listed, the sample desk replies within 1 working day and does not substitute a near value on its own.

pages.title: Ceramic capacitors
pages.content:
Home / Products / Ceramic capacitors

Ceramic capacitors

Ceramic capacitors

Four ceramic series, DC-C0G, DC-X7R, DC-X5R and DC-AQ, cover 0201–1210, 0.5 pF to 100 µF, and 6.3 V to 100 V. DC-AQ is AEC-Q200 qualified.

(01) DC-C0G

DC-C0G, C0G/NP0

DC-C0G is the C0G/NP0 series. It is the ceramic series we offer when a circuit needs a dielectric that stays put, rather than the higher capacitance of X7R or X5R. Chips sit in the same size window as the rest of the family, 0201–1210, inside the family span of 0.5 pF to 100 µF and 6.3 V to 100 V. Parts are taped in Eindhoven and electrically tested before the reel is sealed. Catalogue part numbers from DC-C0G are on the standard 6-week lead time for full reels. Samples of up to five catalogue part numbers, 50 pieces each, are free for a qualified project, and paid kit K-C04 covers 120 values of C0G and X7R in 0402. Amara Osei, applications engineer for capacitors since 2017, is the person who runs DC-bias measurements when a value has to be checked under voltage.

0201–1210 · 0.5 pF–100 µF · 6.3–100 V

X7R

Class 2, decoupling

(02) DC-X7R

DC-X7R

DC-X7R is the X7R series and the series named in the worked example DC 0402 X7R 104 K 500. X7R is the dielectric field in that code. It is the series used when a board needs more capacitance than C0G/NP0 in the same chip size, including the move from 0402 to 0201 described in the Danish hearing-device case. Capacitance of this dielectric depends on the DC voltage across the part, which is why we measure DC-bias rather than quote the nominal value alone. A measurement report, code S-MR, is €180 excluding VAT per part number and is issued in 5 working days. The 0402 kit K-C04 includes X7R values alongside C0G: 120 values, 25 pieces each, at €65 excluding VAT. Full production reels of catalogue X7R parts follow the 6-week standard lead time.

0201–1210 · 0.5 pF–100 µF · 6.3–100 V

X5R

Class 2, decoupling

(03) DC-X5R

DC-X5R

DC-X5R is the X5R series, for decoupling positions that need capacitance in a small chip and can accept the voltage behaviour of this dielectric. It shares the family limits published for ceramic capacitors: sizes 0201–1210, 0.5 pF to 100 µF, and 6.3 V to 100 V. We do not treat the nominal capacitance as the value you will see under bias. Where that matters, the applications review that follows a sample request can include a DC-bias measurement, either as part of the conversation with Amara Osei or as a paid S-MR report. X5R catalogue parts ship from the same three taping lines as the other ceramic series. Outgoing defect rate for the plant, measured as a 12-month rolling customer-confirmed figure, was 0.6 ppm in September 2026.

0201–1210 · 0.5 pF–100 µF · 6.3–100 V

AEC-Q200

Automotive series

(04) DC-AQ

DC-AQ, automotive

DC-AQ is the automotive ceramic series. It is AEC-Q200 qualified, together with DR-AQ and DL-PW. The series is the one we name when a purchasing specification asks for an AEC-Q200 ceramic capacitor from this plant. Sizes, capacitance and voltage stay inside the family window of 0201–1210, 0.5 pF to 100 µF, and 6.3 V to 100 V. Qualification is recorded on the quality page beside ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949:2016 and ISO 14001:2015. IATF 16949 has been in place since 2008. A lot report goes out with samples and can be requested again against a production lot. DC-AQ parts are made on the same Eindhoven lines, sintered at 1,250 °C, and taped after every part has been electrically tested. Sample dispatch for an approved request is 3 working days.

0201–1210 · 0.5 pF–100 µF · 6.3–100 V · AEC-Q200

Specifications

Series specifications

The ceramic table is read by series, then size, capacitance, voltage, tolerance and AEC-Q200. DC-C0G is C0G/NP0. DC-X7R is X7R. DC-X5R is X5R. DC-AQ is the automotive series and is the ceramic series marked AEC-Q200 qualified. All four use the size range 0201–1210, capacitance from 0.5 pF to 100 µF, and voltage from 6.3 V to 100 V. Tolerance is carried as its own field in the part number, as in the K of DC 0402 X7R 104 K 500. The catalogue lists 1,240 part numbers across 13 series, not in this family alone. Figures in a datasheet are the values we measured for that part number. A customer who needs the curve under DC bias orders S-MR rather than scaling the nominal capacitance by a house rule.

Ceramic capacitor series
SeriesSizesCapacitanceVoltageTolerance fieldAEC-Q200
DC-C0G0201–12100.5 pF–100 µF6.3–100 VF, G, JNo
DC-X7R0201–12100.5 pF–100 µF6.3–100 VK, MNo
DC-X5R0201–12100.5 pF–100 µF6.3–100 VK, MNo

Note

DC-bias derating

Class II dielectrics in this range, X7R and X5R, lose capacitance as DC voltage is applied. The nominal value in the part number is the starting point, not the value in the circuit. We measure the DC-bias curve and send it as a measurement report, S-MR, at €180 excluding VAT per part number, in 5 working days. Amara Osei ran those measurements for the hearing-device project in Denmark, when the board moved from 0402 to 0201 X7R to free area. The customer then reported 18% less area on the amplifier board. That figure is the customer’s own measurement, not a plant promise. If bias will sit near the rated voltage, ask for the curve before the layout is frozen. The sample itself still ships against the catalogue part number you named.

pages.title: Chip resistors
pages.content:
Home / Products / Chip resistors

Chip resistors

Chip resistors

Thick-film chip resistors are DR-TF, precision 0.1% DR-PR, anti-sulfur DR-AS and automotive DR-AQ. DR-AQ is AEC-Q200 qualified.

(01) DR-TF

DR-TF, thick film

DR-TF is the thick-film chip resistor series and the general catalogue range. It is the series behind everyday values in the E24 set. The 0402 kit K-R04 packs that set as 170 values, 50 pieces each, at 1%, for €48 excluding VAT. DR-TF parts are taped in Eindhoven on the same lines as the precision, anti-sulfur and automotive series. Catalogue reels are on the 6-week standard lead time. An approved sample request leaves in 3 working days with a datasheet and a lot report. The plant output behind those reels, all four product families together, was 1.8 bn pieces in September 2026. If the design needs 0.1% rather than the kit’s 1%, the series to name is DR-PR, not a selected DR-TF reel.

0201–2512 · 1 Ω–10 MΩ · ±1%, ±5%

0.1%

Precision series

(02) DR-PR

DR-PR, precision 0.1%

DR-PR is the precision thick-film series, specified at 0.1%. Use it when the circuit budget is tighter than the 1% values packed in kit K-R04. The series stays inside the chip-resistor table of size, resistance range, tolerance, TCR and power, and 0.1% is the tolerance we state for this series. We do not publish a second, informal tolerance beside it. Catalogue part numbers follow the 6-week lead time for full reels, and samples follow the usual path: applications review within 1 working day, dispatch in 3 working days, production quote within 5 working days. Up to five catalogue part numbers, 50 pieces each, are free for a qualified project. A measurement that is not already on the datasheet can be ordered as S-MR, at €180 excluding VAT, in 5 working days.

0402–1206 · 10 Ω–1 MΩ · ±0.1%

Anti-sulfur

Sulfur-resistant series

(03) DR-AS

DR-AS, anti-sulfur

DR-AS is the anti-sulfur thick-film series, for boards that have shown resistance drift where sulfur is present. It is the series used on the smart electricity meter in Spain after field drift. On our side that work included a 1,000-hour flowers-of-sulfur test. The customer reports no drift above 0.5% in its own test. That 0.5% is the customer’s result, stated here without extending it to other boards or other hours. DR-AS is a catalogue series, so samples and production reels follow the same desk and the same 6-week lead time as DR-TF. The sample desk is Sofie Brandt, who joined in 2019 and replies within 1 working day. A returned part can also be cross-sectioned under failure analysis, S-FA, at €640 excluding VAT, in 10 working days.

0402–1206 · 1 Ω–10 MΩ · ±1%

AEC-Q200

Automotive series

(04) DR-AQ

DR-AQ, automotive

DR-AQ is the automotive chip-resistor series and is AEC-Q200 qualified, with DC-AQ and DL-PW. Name DR-AQ when the purchasing specification asks for an AEC-Q200 resistor from this plant. It is a thick-film series, separate from the 0.1% precision series DR-PR and from the anti-sulfur series DR-AS. Catalogue parts ship as full reels on the 6-week standard lead time. On-time delivery against the first confirmed date was 97.8% in September 2026. The three months behind that figure were July 97.1%, August 97.5% and September 97.8%. IATF 16949:2016 has been certified here since 2008, which is the system the automotive series is built under. Lot reports are available with samples and on request against a production lot.

0402–1206 · 1 Ω–1 MΩ · ±1% · AEC-Q200

Specifications

Series specifications

The resistor table lists series, sizes, resistance range, tolerance, TCR and power. DR-TF is thick film. DR-PR is precision at 0.1%. DR-AS is anti-sulfur. DR-AQ is automotive and AEC-Q200 qualified. The packed sample of the general range is kit K-R04: E24, 170 values, 50 pieces, 1%, 0402, €48 excluding VAT. Other sizes and values are catalogue part numbers, 1,240 of them across all 13 series. TCR and power are stated on the datasheet for the part number, not as a single figure for the whole family. We measure what the datasheet says and we leave that measured figure to stand on its own. Outgoing defect rate for the plant was 0.6 ppm in September 2026, 12-month rolling and customer-confirmed.

Note

Anti-sulfur testing

Anti-sulfur work on DR-AS is a 1,000-hour flowers-of-sulfur test run on our side, plus the customer’s own measurement. In the Spanish smart-meter case the customer reports no drift above 0.5% in that test of its own. We record the test and the customer’s figure, and we stop there. A different board, a different sulfur level or a different hour count is a different measurement. Where a part has already failed in the field, failure analysis S-FA takes one returned part, prepares a cross-section and writes a report in 10 working days, at €640 excluding VAT. The series to sample after that conversation is DR-AS, requested by part number through the sample desk. Applications review still answers within 1 working day.

pages.title: Inductors and ferrite beads
pages.content:
Home / Products / Inductors and ferrite beads

Inductors and ferrite beads

Inductors and ferrite beads

Magnetic parts are DL-PW power inductors, DL-ML multilayer inductors, DF-FB ferrite beads and DF-HC high-current beads. DL-PW is AEC-Q200 qualified.

(01) DL-PW

DL-PW, power inductors

DL-PW is the shielded power-inductor series. It is AEC-Q200 qualified. The sample kit K-L01 holds 24 values, five pieces each, from this series, at €72 excluding VAT. Parts are specified by inductance, rated current and DCR. Rahul Menon, inductor design lead since 2011, reworked the winding for lower DCR on an e-bike motor controller in Germany. The customer measured 6 °C lower coil temperature at rated current. That temperature is the customer’s measurement on that board. Catalogue DL-PW reels are on the 6-week standard lead time, and approved samples leave in 3 working days with a datasheet and a lot report. A production quote follows within 5 working days. The series is made in Eindhoven and taped on the three taping lines.

2016–5050 · 0.47–100 µH · 0.8–9 A · AEC-Q200

Multilayer

Signal inductor

(02) DL-ML

DL-ML, multilayer inductors

DL-ML is the multilayer inductor series, for positions that need a chip inductor rather than a shielded power cube. It is specified in the same table as the other magnetic parts: size, inductance, rated current and DCR. DL-ML is not the AEC-Q200 power series; that designation belongs to DL-PW. Catalogue part numbers are among the 1,240 in the full catalogue and follow the 6-week lead time for full reels. Samples use the four-stage path used for every family. Send the part numbers, the project and the annual quantity. Applications review replies within 1 working day. Dispatch is 3 working days, and the production quote is within 5 working days. Up to five catalogue part numbers, 50 pieces each, are free for a qualified project. Mei-Lin Huang, supply planning lead since 2015, holds the lead-time plan those dates come from.

0402–1008 · 1 nH–10 µH · 0.05–0.9 A

(03) DF-FB

DF-FB, ferrite beads

DF-FB is the ferrite chip-bead series. Beads are specified by impedance at 100 MHz, rated current and DCR, not by inductance. They sit on the same plant flow as the inductors: powder through to a taped reel, with an electrical test of every part before the reel is sealed. Kit K-F01 mixes DF-FB with the high-current series DF-HC: 30 values, 20 pieces each, at €39 excluding VAT. Shipping for a kit is €12 within the EU and €28 elsewhere. The free sample allowance is separate from the kit and covers up to five catalogue part numbers, 50 pieces each, on a qualified project. September 2026 sample dispatch, once a request is approved, is stated as 3 working days, which is the figure on the monthly ledger.

0201–1206 · 10–2,000 Ω at 100 MHz · 0.1–3 A

High current

Chip bead

(04) DF-HC

DF-HC, high-current beads

DF-HC is the high-current ferrite bead series, paired with DF-FB in kit K-F01. The specification columns are the same: size, impedance at 100 MHz, rated current and DCR. Choose DF-HC when the current is the reason a standard bead will not do, and name the catalogue part number rather than a current in the email alone. The sample desk, Sofie Brandt, answers within 1 working day. Approved requests are dispatched in 3 working days. If the datasheet curve is not enough, a measurement report S-MR covers an impedance curve as well as a DC-bias curve, at €180 excluding VAT per part number, in 5 working days. Failure analysis of one returned part is S-FA, €640 excluding VAT, in 10 working days. Production reels remain on the 6-week catalogue lead time.

0603–1206 · 22–600 Ω at 100 MHz · 2–6 A

Specifications

Series specifications

The magnetic-parts table lists series, size, inductance or impedance at 100 MHz, rated current and DCR. DL-PW is the power inductor and is AEC-Q200 qualified. DL-ML is the multilayer inductor. DF-FB is the ferrite bead. DF-HC is the high-current bead. Impedance at 100 MHz is the bead column; inductance is the inductor column. Rated current and DCR are stated per part number. We do not fold those into one family typical. Kit quantities are fixed: K-L01 is 24 values of DL-PW, five pieces, €72; K-F01 is 30 values of DF-FB and DF-HC, 20 pieces, €39. All prices exclude VAT. Rahul Menon is the design lead for this page. Questions about a winding change go through the sample request, with the annual quantity attached, so planning and design see the same file.

These are the figures we measured for September 2026. Output was 1.8 bn pieces in the month, all four families, shipped. Outgoing defect rate was 0.6 ppm, 12-month rolling and customer-confirmed. On-time delivery was 97.8% against the first confirmed date. Standard lead time was 6 weeks for catalogue parts on full reels. The catalogue held 1,240 part numbers across 13 series. Sample dispatch was 3 working days from an approved request. The wording on each line is the definition we keep, so a later month can be compared with this one. We publish the count we measured, with the month kept on the figure. The ledger is issued from the Eindhoven plant at Kanaalweg Oost 18, where the lab and the office sit in the same address.

Two lines carry the previous months in the same definitions. Outgoing defect rate was 0.7 ppm in July, 0.6 ppm in August and 0.6 ppm in September, still the 12-month rolling customer-confirmed count. On-time delivery against the first confirmed date was 97.1% in July, 97.5% in August and 97.8% in September. The other four ledger lines are published as the September figures: output 1.8 bn pieces, standard lead time 6 weeks, catalogue 1,240 part numbers, sample dispatch 3 working days. Tomasz Wierzba, head of quality since 2009, is responsible for the table. A customer who wants the lot behind a shipment, rather than the plant-level month, asks for a lot report. The request uses the same sample desk address, samples@denki-components.example.

Request a lot report

Certificates

Certificates

Four qualifications are current and dated from the year they started here. ISO 9001:2015 has been in place since 1996, the year of the first MLCC line. IATF 16949:2016 has been in place since 2008, the year inductors were added. ISO 14001:2015 has been in place since 2011. AEC-Q200 applies to the qualified series DC-AQ, DR-AQ and DL-PW, not to every series in the catalogue. Certificate copies are available with a lot-report request. The plant employs 420 people and runs 24 hours a day in three shifts, which is the operation these certificates cover. They are not a statement about a particular reel. For a reel, ask for the lot report and the part number.

Lot report

What a lot report contains

A lot report identifies the lot and the part number and records the electrical test done before taping. Every reel is sealed only after each part on it has been electrically tested on the taping lines. The report is the document that travels with a sample dispatch, alongside the datasheet, and it can be requested again for a production lot. It is not a substitute for the monthly ledger. The ledger is the plant figure for the month. The lot report is the lot you received. Measurement that goes beyond that document is ordered separately: S-MR for a DC-bias or impedance curve, €180 excluding VAT, 5 working days, or S-FA for one returned part, a cross-section and a report, €640 excluding VAT, 10 working days. Ask by part number and lot.

Head of quality

From the head of quality

Tomasz Wierzba, head of quality, joined in 2009. He asked that the September note stay in his words: “The monthly ledger is the set of figures we measured, published with the month on them so a buyer can compare like with like. I would rather show July, August and September than replace 0.6 ppm with a slogan.” Those two sentences are the note for this month. Questions about a figure go to the quality group through the contact page or, where the question is a sample or a lot report, to samples@denki-components.example. The phone number for the office is +31 40 000 1987 during Mon–Fri 08:00–17:30 CET. The plant itself runs outside those office hours.

Request a lot report

Samples and services

Samples and services

Kits, measurement reports and failure analysis are priced on this page in EUR, excluding VAT. The sample desk answers within 1 working day.

Price list

Sample kits and lab services

Prices are in EUR and exclude VAT. K-C04, capacitor kit 0402, is 120 values, 25 pieces each, C0G and X7R, at €65. K-R04, resistor kit 0402, is the E24 set, 170 values, 50 pieces each, at 1%, for €48. K-L01, power inductor kit, is 24 values, five pieces each, DL-PW series, at €72. K-F01, ferrite bead kit, is 30 values, 20 pieces each, DF-FB and DF-HC, at €39. S-MR, measurement report, is a DC-bias or impedance curve per part number, in 5 working days, at €180. S-FA, failure analysis, is one returned part, a cross-section and a report, in 10 working days, at €640. Kit shipping is €12 within the EU and €28 elsewhere. The list is the whole price list.

Free pieces

Free pieces and shipping

Up to 5 catalogue part numbers, 50 pieces each, are free for a qualified project. The allowance is in pieces of catalogue parts, not in kits. Kits K-C04, K-R04, K-L01 and K-F01 are paid at the prices above, plus shipping of €12 within the EU or €28 elsewhere. A qualified project states the part numbers, the application and the annual quantity so Mei-Lin Huang’s planning group can see the volume behind the request. If a part number is not among the 1,240 in the catalogue, the desk says so within 1 working day. Paid lab work is only S-MR and S-FA. No other bench fee is listed. Prices are the same in every language on this site.

How it moves

How a request moves

A sample request has four stages and no parallel track. First, send the part numbers, the project and the annual quantity. Second, applications review answers within 1 working day. # ceramics

Front of the ceramic line

Powder, casting, stacking

The process is six stages, kept in this order. Stage one is powder and slurry, the start of a ceramic lot. Stage two is tape casting and printing: a thin ceramic film spread on a carrier, then the print that defines the electrode pattern. Stage three is stacking and dicing, where the green sheets are stacked on the vacuum table and cut. These three stages are the front of the ceramic line and the reason a part number fixes size and dielectric before a reel exists. Resistor paste, inductor windings and ferrite beads join their own routes and meet the ceramic lots again at termination and at the taping lines. Lucas Ferreira, process engineer for the taping lines since 2013, is the engineer who walks this route with visitors.

Back of the line

Sintering, termination, test

Stage four is sintering. The kiln is at 1,250 °C. Stage five is termination and plating. Stage six is test and taping, and the figure we attach to that stage is an electrical test of every part before a reel is sealed. Three taping lines do that work, and line 3 has now run a full month. Reels then go to the store, which holds 41,000 reels, or straight into a sample shipment. Sample dispatch from an approved request is 3 working days. Catalogue production reels are on a 6-week standard lead time. Outgoing defect rate, measured as we publish it, was 0.6 ppm in September 2026. The six stages describe the route a lot takes. The lot report is the record of the test on the lot you receive.

Lucas Ferreira joined in 2013 and is process engineer for the taping lines. pages.content:
Home / Cases

Cases

Cases

Three boards, three measured outcomes, each reported by the customer. Countries and product types are named; the customers are not.

(Case 01) Hearing device, Denmark

0201 capacitors free 18% board area

A hearing-device maker in Denmark needed board area on an amplifier and moved from 0402 to 0201 X7R capacitors. The series was DC-X7R. Amara Osei, applications engineer for capacitors, ran the DC-bias measurements so the smaller chip was chosen against the capacitance under voltage, not against the nominal code alone. The customer reports 18% less area on the amplifier board. That 18% is the customer’s measurement of its own board. We do not extend it to other layouts. The part numbers stayed inside the ceramic window of 0201–1210 and 0.5 pF to 100 µF. Samples went through the usual desk: review within 1 working day, dispatch in 3 working days with datasheet and lot report. The production lead time quoted for the catalogue reels was 6 weeks.

Customer-reported: 18% less area on the amplifier board

(Case 02) E-bike motor controller, Germany

Cooler windings at rated current

An e-bike motor controller made in Germany used DL-PW power inductors. The series was qualified to AEC-Q200. Rahul Menon, inductor design lead, reworked the winding for lower DCR. The customer measured 6 °C lower coil temperature at rated current. The 6 °C is the customer’s measurement at that current on that controller. It is not a rating we attach to every DL-PW part. The series remains the shielded power inductor in kit K-L01, 24 values, five pieces, €72 excluding VAT, and in the catalogue at the 6-week lead time. DCR, inductance and rated current stay on the part-number line of the specification table. A follow-on impedance or DC-bias style curve, where the datasheet is not enough, is measurement report S-MR at €180 excluding VAT, in 5 working days.

Customer-measured: 6 °C lower coil temperature at rated current

(Case 03) Smart electricity meter, Spain

No resistor drift after field failures

A smart electricity meter in Spain had shown field drift and moved to DR-AS anti-sulfur resistors. On our side the work included a 1,000-hour flowers-of-sulfur test. The customer reports no drift above 0.5% in its own test. The 0.5% and the customer’s test are stated as that customer’s result. We do not turn them into a drift limit for other meters. DR-AS remains the anti-sulfur catalogue series, sampled through Sofie Brandt’s desk and supplied on the 6-week lead time when the quote is accepted. A returned part from the earlier build can be examined as failure analysis S-FA: one part, a cross-section and a report, €640 excluding VAT, 10 working days. The monthly plant defect rate is a separate figure. In September 2026 it was 0.6 ppm, 12-month rolling, customer-confirmed.

Customer-reported: no drift above 0.5% in its own test

(About) Since 1987

The company

About

Denki Components B.V. has made passive parts in Eindhoven since 1987, beginning with 14 people and disc capacitors. The managing director is Ingrid Vass, who joined in 2004.

History

Since 1987

Denki Components B.V. was founded in 1987 with 14 people, making disc capacitors. In 1996 the first multilayer ceramic capacitor line started, and ISO 9001 was certified the same year. The current certificate is ISO 9001:2015, held since that 1996 start. In 2008 the plant added inductors and certified IATF 16949, now IATF 16949:2016. In 2016 the ferrite bead line started. In 2024 taping line 3 was added. The plant, lab and office are still at Kanaalweg Oost 18, 5644 RK Eindhoven, Netherlands. Four families now leave the reel lines: ceramic capacitors, thick-film chip resistors, power inductors and ferrite beads. The catalogue holds 1,240 part numbers across 13 series. posts.title: Taping line 3 runs its first full month
posts.excerpt: Taping line 3, added in 2024, has finished its first full month beside the two older lines at the Eindhoven plant.
posts.content:
Taping line 3 has finished its first full month. The line was added in 2024 at the Denki Components B.V. plant in Eindhoven, and it now runs with the two lines that were already here.

All three seal a reel only after every part has been electrically tested. The parts on the carrier are the same four families the plant has shipped for years: multilayer ceramic capacitors, thick-film chip resistors, power inductors and ferrite chip beads. Lucas Ferreira has been process engineer for the taping lines since 2013. He treats line 3 as extra capacity in the same process, not as a separate factory.

Powder and slurry, tape casting and printing, stacking and dicing, sintering, termination and plating, then test and taping: that order is unchanged. The kiln that feeds the ceramic lots still runs at 1,250 °C. Finished reels still go to the store, which holds 41,000 reels, or into a sample box when the desk has approved a request. The published month for the plant is September 2026.

Output was 1.8 bn pieces shipped, counted across all four families. Outgoing defect rate was 0.6 ppm, on the 12-month rolling customer-confirmed definition. On-time delivery against the first confirmed date was 97.8%.

The two months before that were 0.7 ppm and 97.1% in July, and 0.6 ppm and 97.5% in August. Standard lead time for catalogue parts on full reels stayed at 6 weeks. The catalogue stayed at 1,240 part numbers across 13 series.

Sample dispatch stayed at 3 working days from an approved request. Line 3 did not come with a new set of definitions. Tomasz Wierzba, head of quality since 2009, publishes those figures so a buyer can compare one month with the next. The building those reels leave is the only site.

Plant, lab and office are at Kanaalweg Oost 18, 5644 RK Eindhoven, Netherlands. The company was founded in 1987 with 14 people, making disc capacitors. The first multilayer ceramic line and ISO 9001 arrived in 1996.

Inductors and IATF 16949 arrived in 2008. The ferrite bead line arrived in 2016. ISO 14001:2015 has been held since 2011.

Four hundred and twenty people work here, in three shifts, 24 hours a day. Office hours remain Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:30 CET, which is when the phone +31 40 000 1987 is answered. What a buyer can ask for has not changed with the new line. Sofie Brandt, on the sample desk since 2019, still answers samples@denki-components.example within 1 working day.

A request needs part numbers, the project and the annual quantity. Applications review comes back inside that day. Samples then leave in 3 working days with a datasheet and a lot report.

A production quote follows within 5 working days. Mei-Lin Huang, supply planning lead since 2015, holds the plan behind the 6-week catalogue lead time. Up to 5 catalogue part numbers, 50 pieces each, remain free for a qualified project. The 2026 kits are unchanged: K-C04 at €65, K-R04 at €48, K-L01 at €72 and K-F01 at €39, excluding VAT.

Shipping is €12 within the EU and €28 elsewhere. A DC-bias or impedance curve is still S-MR at €180, in 5 working days. Failure analysis of one returned part is still S-FA at €640, in 10 working days. AEC-Q200 still applies only to DC-AQ, DR-AQ and DL-PW.

Amara Osei still runs capacitor DC-bias measurements. Rahul Menon still takes inductor winding questions. An open day is set for 14 November at the same address, during office hours, while the shifts continue.

Line 3’s first full month means one more taper in a process the ledger already describes. The figures above are the ones we measured.
